spec.seam: run_warmspread grew a raw= parameter this round: before it loaded the universe itself, so a twin could not burn both arms off one load
spec.join: _warmspread_arm_cells harvests per-era warm/cold spreads, dead-block bars, both curve faces and the answers scalars; _warmspread_arm_dates harvests the ORDERS themselves, because an ordering can flip without any spread moving past the delta floor

cutoff_control.comparison: old raw arm vs today raw arm (arm held fixed)

answers.delta_units: each delta is in the units of its column: bp for spreads, percent per year for ann_return_pct, bars for dead_block_bars -- the summary max is a max over mixed units and is a screen, not a quantity
answers.reading: the repair reaches the warm-spread face: 17 of 68 cells move (8 wide, 4 spread, 0 ladder, 5 other), 0 ordering claim(s) move, and 0 cell(s) exist on one arm only

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking
the screened arm repairs prints inside the panel it is handed; it does not add or remove bars, so an unchanged universe_members count is a property of the repair, not evidence the panel is clean
the warm curve pays the burn-in before the measured span by construction, so a spread move on the warm arm can be a slightly different weight path rather than a different decision
the five-name ladder is a constant list: a moved ladder cell names a defect in the join or the cache, not a repair effect
orderings are read off the published face verbatim; a tie in spread would make the order arbitrary and is disclosed by the raw spread map rather than smoothed away
